args.lesson: dds_250msps (NCO/DDS for DUC, >=250 MSPS, err<=2^-13, min luts): run_dse with the full 400-eval budget produced a 30-design feasible non-dominated front, all pipelined-family. Min-luts winner: pipelined data_width=18,n_iter=15,angle_guard=2,frac_guard=0,rounding=round -> luts=920 (est), accuracy_bits=13.2, ffs=953, throughput_msps=264 (est), max_abs_err=0.000109 (exact, 2^-13.17). Lessons: (1) for this spec class the pipelined family dominates; extra n_iter buys accuracy at ~65 LUTs/iteration, and data_width=19 + frac_guard=1 + trunc is the cheaper route to >14 accuracy bits than pushing n_iter at W=18. (2) No system scenario => no sys_* bounds, so simulate_system is unnecessary; the graph's internal L2 shortlist suffices. (3) L3/L4/L5 had no recorded rows for this design (verify_rtl declines live W=18 exhaustive runs; L4 never run live; back_annotate returns no_measured_data => no winner change, no reexplore). So the final numbers stay L1 estimates except the exact golden-model error. (4) Watch thin margins: min-luts pick sits only ~11% under the error limit and ~5.6% over the throughput requirement; the safer fallback is n_iter=16 (luts=985, err=8.35e-05).
